name: How to audit an AI-generated UI
caption:
Auditing AI-generated UI isn't about re-designing from scratch, it's about spot-checking key details. Here's a quick 3-step framework to review AI UI components before they go live:

Hierarchy: Can you tell what matters in three seconds?
States: Check empty, error, loading, and long-text cases.
System: Compare spacing, typography, and color against your core design tokens.

Trust the generation, but always verify the details. What's your go-to check when reviewing AI UI design? Let us know below!
